author: migration-implementer
note: self-run by the implementer; certification is the reviewer's
changes: Fix for round-1 review blocking finding on requirement D: main() now validates each loaded inventory's shape (pgMajor is an integer; extensions/schemas/constraints/indexes/sequences/views/functions/triggers/roles are arrays; tables is an object whose entries each have array columns and array primaryKey) via a new validateInventory() before diffInventories() runs, and writes 'invalid inventory <path>: <field>' to stderr with exitCode 2 instead of letting a structurally-invalid-but-valid-JSON input (e.g. --b {} or --b null, or an inventory with pgMajor missing on both sides, which previously passed silently via undefined === undefined) crash inside diffInventories() with an uncaught TypeError and exit 1 (the 'diffs found' code). The diffInventories() call and the --out writeFileSync() are now also wrapped in try/catch, each setting exitCode 2 on failure instead of throwing past main() (an unwritable --out path is now exit 2, not an uncaught exception). No other requirement-A/B/C/D behavior changed: NOT NULL semantics, PLATFORM_MANAGED_SCHEMAS ignoring, --accept-pg-major acceptance rule, and the output JSON shape (pgMajor/accepted/ignored/normalized) are unchanged from attempt 1, which the round-1 review already verified against the real P4.3 inventories (0 diffs with --accept-pg-major 18, exactly 1 pgMajor diff without it). Added 4 self-test cases for the fix: --b {}, --b null, pgMajor missing on both sides, and an unwritable --out path, all now exit 2 via the CLI.
